candidate_muscles: Deep Cervical Flexors as proximal driver
directions.isolation_logic: Microscope posture isolates sustained flexion: If elbow flexion pain in microscope posture but full pain-free supine, driver = sustained postural + cervical/thoracic driver not local joint. Test supine pure flexion vs sitting microscope posture with cervical flexion 20deg + shoulder protraction. NKT: Biceps Brachii vs Brachialis isolation - Brachialis tested with forearm pronated, Biceps supinated. If Brachialis weak and Pronator Teres overactive, synergistic dominance.
directions.retest_rule: After cervical SNAG C5-C6 + thoracic extension PA T4-6 + biceps/brachialis NKT release facilitated pronator teres 45sec + activate brachialis 3x5sec, retest microscope posture elbow flexion tolerance time: baseline 20min pain 7/10 -> target >60min pain <3/10 = >50% improvement driver confirmed. Also retest elbow flexion ROM pain-free supine vs microscope posture.
directions.microscope_ergonomics: Surgeon 10H microscope: Elbow flexion sustained 90-110deg, forearm pronation 70%, shoulder abduction 30-45deg, cervical flexion 20-30deg, static load. Check workstation height, armrest support, oculars adjustment to reduce cervical flexion.

candidate_muscles: Lower Trap as proximal stability driver
directions.isolation_logic: If elbow extension limited after 10H sustained flexion, check triceps inhibition due to biceps hypertonicity reciprocal inhibition. NKT: Test triceps long head vs biceps. If triceps weak and biceps strong, reciprocal inhibition. Also check radial nerve mechanosensitivity - extension with wrist flexion sensitizes radial.
compensation_watch: Wrist flexion to avoid triceps stretch
directions.retest_rule: After triceps NKT release biceps 45sec + activate triceps 3x5sec + radial nerve slider median bias, retest terminal extension pain/ROM - >20deg gain or pain -3/10 = positive

directions.isolation_logic: Pronator Teres vs Pronator Quadratus isolation: Teres tested elbow flexed 90deg, Quadratus tested elbow extended pronation only. If pronator teres overactive and supinator (Biceps + Supinator muscle) inhibited, synergistic dominance drives lateral epicondylalgia. Surgeon microscope pronation 70% sustained drives pronator teres hypertonicity. NKT: Test supinator weak -> challenge pronator teres rub -> supinator strong = reactive pair confirmed. Also check median nerve pronator teres syndrome - median nerve compression between two heads pronator teres.
directions.retest_rule: After pronator teres release 60sec pin-stretch + supinator activation 3x5sec + median nerve slider, retest pronation ROM pain and microscope instrument handling tolerance - >30% improvement pain reduction = positive. Also retest lateral epicondyle palpation pain.

directions.isolation_logic: Supinator muscle isolated with elbow extended pronation to supination (biceps less active when elbow extended). Biceps supination tested elbow flexed 90deg supinated. If supinator weak and pronator teres hypertonic, synergistic dominance. Surgeon loses supination after 10H pronation sustained. Check radial nerve supinator tunnel - radial nerve passes through supinator muscle (Arcade of Frohse) - radial tunnel syndrome can mimic lateral epicondylalgia. NKT: Test supinator weak -> rub pronator teres -> supinator strong = reactive pair.
directions.retest_rule: After pronator teres release 60sec + supinator activation + radial nerve slider (radial bias ULNT2b), retest supination ROM pain - >25deg gain or pain -3/10 = positive. Retest lateral epicondyle pain with Cozen test.

candidate_muscles: Extensor Carpi Radialis Brevis ECRB (lateral epicondylalgia)
Serratus Anterior / Lower Trap proximal stability
directions.isolation_logic: Surgeon microscope 10H: Sustained low-load grip + pronation + elbow flexion + shoulder protraction + cervical flexion = cumulative overload. ECRB is key lateral epicondylalgia driver - weak and painful resisted wrist extension middle finger extension. NKT: Test ECRB weak -> challenge flexor digitorum or pronator teres -> ECRB strong = synergistic dominance flexors over extensors. Also check C6-C7 contribution cervical driver: cervical flexion 20-30deg sustained 10H compresses C6-C7, inhibits triceps ECRB. Test dependency: Does cervical retraction + thoracic extension improve grip pain? If yes, cervical driver. Does scapular setting improve elbow pain? If yes, scapular driver.
compensation_watch: Shoulder shrug upper trap overactive vs lower trap serratus inhibited
directions.retest_rule: Microscope posture retest protocol: Baseline grip tolerance 20min pain 7/10 lateral epicondyle + Cozen test positive. Intervention sequence per Master Hierarchy: 1 Clear scars if any (e.g., previous elbow surgery), 2 Clear ligamentous ATFL analogy for elbow: check lateral collateral ligament laxity, 3 Cranio-respiratory: cervical SNAG C5-C6 + diaphragm breathing 90/90, 4 Subsystems: POS/AOS? For elbow: Posterior Oblique? Actually check thoracic extension, 5 Local NKT: Release pronator teres flexor digitorum 60sec FIRST -> Activate ECRB supinator triceps 3x5sec SECOND, 6 Taping: ECRB facilitation Origin->Insertion 25-50% + pronator teres inhibition Insertion->Origin 0-15% + decompression over lateral epicondyle cross-pattern 50% center. Retest microscope grip tolerance >60min pain <3/10 + Cozen pain -50% + grip strength dynamometer +20% = positive driver confirmed.

microscope_ergonomics_detailed.workstation: Microscope oculars height adjustable to reduce cervical flexion from 45deg to 20deg, armrests at elbow height to support 90-110deg flexion reducing biceps/brachialis static load, forearm support reduces pronator teres overload
microscope_ergonomics_detailed.microbreaks: Every 30min: 20sec cervical retraction + thoracic extension over chair + elbow extension pronation stretch + wrist extensor stretch + diaphragmatic breathing 3 breaths + scapular setting lower trap activation
microscope_ergonomics_detailed.instrument: Lightweight instruments 0.2kg, ergonomic grip diameter 8-12mm to reduce flexor digitorum overuse, neutral wrist splint if needed during non-surgical tasks
microscope_ergonomics_detailed.posture: Elbow flexion 90-110deg supported, shoulder abduction <30deg, scapula posterior tilt, lumbar neutral with footrest, avoid trunk lean
